_generated: generated by running both reference implementations as sealed programs on this board under a generous routing budget (up to 500 passes and a 300 s wall-clock budget per run; reference A given 8 worker threads, reference B allowed up to 30 stagnant passes) and measuring the resulting Layout under the spec's connectivity and DRC rules; the best (lowest incomplete-after with no added violation) of the runs is reported per reference

budget.runsPerReference: reference A up to 2 (its parallel search varies between runs; the lowest incomplete-after is reported); reference B 1 (its search is deterministic)

notes: Reference A joins all but 1 connection with no added Violation, matching the `routing-slow-issue034-green14seg-default` bound of at most 1. Reference B leaves 6 but does so by adding Violations under this budget, so its run does not satisfy R-1; reference A's clean 1 is the admissible best. traceLengthMm is each reference's own reported routed-copper length in millimetres; the two references report on different length scales on some boards (a units-resolution difference), so the two are not directly comparable, and the figure is advisory.
